item.title: OpenAI Benchmarks Jalapeño Against Nvidia AI Chips
item.description: OpenAI says its first inference chip delivers lower latency and more work per watt across three large open-weight models.

item.title: Perplexity Runs Its Computer Agent on Local Hardware
item.description: Portable Computer keeps agent planning, file analysis and tool execution on a DGX Spark, escalating to cloud models only with permission.

item.title: Entertainment Majors Back Stability AI’s $76M Round
item.description: EA and three global music groups joined Stability AI’s Series B, tying its next phase more closely to licensed creative production.

item.title: Gradio Adds Visual Workflows That Deploy as APIs
item.description: Gradio’s new Workflow interface turns typed AI pipelines into inspectable canvases, callable REST endpoints and deployable applications.

item.title: OpenAI Exposes Russian Network Built Around Fake Think Tank
item.description: OpenAI banned accounts tied to a covert Russian campaign that used ChatGPT to promote a fabricated institute and stolen scholarship.

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Evening edition, Aug 25
item.description: · OpenAI released an Admin plugin enabling ChatGPT Work and Codex administrators to manage users and permissions conversationally.（IT之家） · Figma increased AI add-on credits across every plan, doubling Pro allowances and raising Organization and Enterprise allocations by 60%.（Figma） · Nvidia previewed Dynamo shadow engine recovery, which maintains a standby LLM engine to reduce lost inference capacity after crashes.（NVIDIA AI） · Adobe added Animation Generator to Firefly, turning children’s ideas and other prompts into animated visual creations.（Adobe Firefly） · Together AI added Qwen3.8-27B support for fine-tuning and deployment through dedicated model inference infrastructure.（Together AI） · Google introduced AgentHands, an XR research prototype generating synchronized, spatially grounded hand gestures for conversational agents.（Google Research） · Gemini’s macOS app added voice-driven dictation, file summarization, and text rewriting directly inside other application windows.（Gemini） · GitHub Next proposed a “knowledge compressor” for rigorously shrinking accumulated specifications and reducing the context consumed by coding agents.（GitHub Next） · Anthropic unified Claude’s memory across chat and Cowork, while letting users inspect, edit, delete, or disable remembered topics.（Claude） · Recraft redesigned Studio around Create, Edit, and Chat tabs while retaining vector editing, styles, and mockup workflows.（Recraft） · HeyGen removed LiveAvatar API concurrency limits and advertised scalable full-body 1080p avatar sessions starting at one cent per minute.（HeyGen） · IBM released Apache-2.0-licensed Granite 4.2 reasoning models in 3B, 8B, and 30B sizes, featuring tool calling and up to 512K context.（Hugging Face） · AI presentation company Gamma acquired design startup Lica, whose founders will lead a new design research laboratory.（TechCrunch） · ElevenLabs launched Composer for Music v2, enabling section-level editing of lyrics, arrangement, duration, tempo, and key.（ElevenLabs）

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Morning edition, Aug 25
item.description: · Recraft showcased V4.1 prompts producing playful, fully editable vector illustrations.（X @recraftai） · Tripo highlighted a workflow converting images into reconstructed geometry for programmable Three.js experiences.（X @tripoai） · Fourth Paradigm and more than ten robotics companies launched a collaboration initiative around the open-source PhanthyMotus embodied-agent framework.（量子位） · Shanghai’s robot carnival offered a public glimpse of humanoids moving from staged demonstrations toward everyday entertainment and service roles.（MIT Technology Review） · Taiwanese cybersecurity researchers reported that AI tools have more than doubled the pace of Chinese state-backed cyberattacks.（The Decoder） · Qdrant showcased an offline warehouse-robot search pipeline combining Qdrant Edge with MobileCLIP2 to match products without network access.（X @qdrant_engine） · Lovart added Seedance 2.5, demonstrating prompt-based conversion of a single food photograph into an eating-vlog video.（X @lovart_ai） · Alibaba made Wan 3.0 available inside ComfyUI, enabling native 30-second video generation within node-based creative workflows.（X @Alibaba_Wan） · ScienceClaw introduced AutoProject, an engine that plans, executes, verifies and repairs multi-step scientific research projects.（量子位） · Pika added Wan 3.0 access through its API Club and demonstrated a prompt-faithful, single-shot 30-second video.（X @pika_labs） · Artificial Analysis measured Gemma 4 31B at 3,431 output tokens per second on Nvidia’s Groq 3 LPX demonstration endpoint.（X @ArtificialAnlys） · Milvus integrated MemSearch with DeepSeek Harness, adding persistent project memory and cross-agent continuity.（X @milvusio） · MiniMax published an ecosystem index cataloguing H3 integrations, including options designed for systems with 24GB of VRAM.（X @MiniMax_AI） · Adobe promoted Firefly’s Generate Music feature for creating soundtracks from user-provided moments and ideas.（X @AdobeFirefly）
